strategic_classification.industry_position: Table Stakes moving to Emerging Trend — AI embedded throughout the product at scale; NLP filters and review AI becoming baseline expectation
strategic_classification.saudia_feasibility: OTA-Adjacent — Booking.com's strength is accommodation inventory Saudia doesn't own; but AI patterns (NLP filters, review clustering, contextual Q&A) are transferable
strategic_classification.saudia_timeline: Short-term (6–18 months) for pattern adoption; Medium-term (18–36 months) for cultural AI personalization at Saudia's scale

executive_recommendation.description: 5–8 AI pre-generated, flight-specific questions on every Saudia flight detail page — answering the exact concerns that cause booking abandonment before the user needs to ask them.
executive_recommendation.why_it_matters: Booking.com proves that surfacing anticipated questions at the decision moment eliminates hesitation. The gap between flight consideration and booking is often a single unanswered question — about fare rules, baggage, or connections. AI chips close that gap instantly and silently.
executive_recommendation.business_impact: Directly reduces booking abandonment on flight detail pages. Reduces call center volume on the three most common pre-booking inquiry categories. Can ship in 4–6 weeks with no new infrastructure — content + FAQ integration only.
